Diana Wright is characterized by her black, brilliant eyes. Her appearance features rosy cheeks accompanied by enchanting dimples.

## History

In her youth, Diana Wright vowed eternal friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in the garden at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Years later, [Diana](../character/diana.md) held her small child in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) garret while chatting with [Anne](../character/anne.md) about [Anne](../character/anne.md) finishing her teaching duties, her upcoming marriage to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and her plans to move to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P3](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P9](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P15](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016), +18 more_

## Quotes

> “Your wedding dress is a dream, anyhow,” sighed Diana rapturously. “You’ll look like a perfect queen in it—you’re so tall and slender. How DO you keep so slim, Anne? I’m fatter than ever—I’ll soon have no waist at all.”
>
> — Diana Wright — [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P25](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0025)

> “You always hated geometry,” said Diana with a retrospective smile. “I should think you’d be real glad to be through with teaching, anyhow.”
>
> — Diana Wright — [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P3](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0003)

> “Sixty! It might as well be six hundred,” sighed Diana. “I never can get further from home now than Charlottetown.”
>
> — Diana Wright — [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P17](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0017)

> "Oh, Anne, where? I do hope it’s near here."
>
> — Diana Wright — [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P15](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0015)

> "Is it settled yet where you are going to live?"
>
> — Diana Wright — [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P9](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0009)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--diana-wright.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) is a close personal friend of [Diana](../character/diana.md). The two maintain a warm, long-standing bond as they navigate major life milestones together, including Anne's upcoming marriage and Diana's role as a mother.

- Friend of — close personal friends  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P15](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0015)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-wright.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) are longtime friends who once vowed eternal friendship to one another. Their bond remains strong as they spend time together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), discussing Diana's young child and Anne's preparations to marry [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and relocate to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor).

- Friend of — longtime friends who vowed eternal friendship (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
